name: Jujutsu Tycoon
desc:
Like 👍 and favorite ⭐ for more Updates & Codes!

Welcome to Jujutsu Tycoon! Build your own Jujutsu High, unlock powerful cursed techniques, and fight challenging bosses to become The Strongest. 

💾 Each Tycoon has its own save file, cash resets when switching Tycoons.
💎 Rebirth tycoon to unlock unique skills and boost stats to defeat enemies.
🔒 Buy Locked Jujutsu with Yen from completing Rebirths, Bosses & Quest
💥 Fight Enemies with powerful abilities to become the Strongest.

New Update Is Out!
- Curse Manipulation Jujutsu!
- 3 New Powers!
- New Sukona Boss!
- Powers now save on Exit!
- Improvements!

Controls (PC):
🔥 Dash - Q / Double Jump - Double Space / Weapon Ability - V🔥 

Note: This game is not designed to save your Cash, only your Tycoon, Powers, Jujutsu, Level and Yen Saves.
